updates.title: Premature redemption under Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) Scheme - Redemption Price for premature redemption of SGB 2020-21 Series VIII due on November 18, 2026
updates.body: RBI press release. Open the source for the figures.

updates.title: Inflation rose to 6.09% in October
updates.body: CPI inflation moved above the RBI's 6% upper limit (September: 5.54%). At 6.09% inflation, PPF's 7.1% is a real return of about 1%, and a 6.25% FD is negative after tax.

updates.title: RBI raised the repo rate to 5.50%
updates.body: First hike since February 2023 (from 5.25%). When rates rise, existing bond prices fall and new deposits tend to pay more. The 10-year G-Sec yield is around 7.3%.

updates.title: Small savings rates unchanged for Oct-Dec 2026
updates.body: PPF 7.1%, NSC 7.7%, 5-year TD 7.5%. Tenth quarter without a change. Next review around 31 December.

updates.title: Gold and silver import duty raised to 15%
updates.body: Up from 6%. Indian gold prices include this duty, so they sit well above the international price.

updates.title: SGBs bought on the exchange lost their tax-free exit
updates.body: Only original subscribers who hold to maturity keep the capital-gains exemption. This matters because exchange purchase is now the only way to buy an SGB.
